reviews.comment: Great case, especially for the price. I recommend.

reviews.title: Excellent case, beautiful color
reviews.comment: Very well built case, plenty of hardware, cables labeled properly, no issues whatsoever, looks great even with black components!
reviews.author: Brandan

reviews.title: Great, good looking case!
reviews.comment: Case arrived in great condition, looks great and was very easy to work with. Magnetic dust filters are a big plus as well as the unified front panel connector makes wiring a lot less of a chore.
reviews.author: ChristanR

reviews.title: Absolutely Gorgeous
reviews.comment:
What a stunning PC case this is. I built my wife her own PC recently using this case, and it is just absolutely beautiful. She loves it!

The easy-to-remove panels are a huge plus!
reviews.author: KevinL

reviews.title: Lovely color
reviews.comment: Came with a dent in the bottom which made putting the power supply in an absolute nightmare and USB 3.0 plugin for my motherboard lays right next to one of the fans making it an awkward plugin. The case in general is gorgeous and the color is everything I was hoping for, very worth it in the end.
reviews.author: Hazel
